thread:
maria: quick question — i'm triaging a 500s spike on api-prod and need to pull a few request traces. before i do, can someone confirm the minimal safe steps so i don't leak PII? specifically: 1) are we allowed to capture full request payloads in `/tmp` for < 24h? 2) do I need explicit approval for ephemeral SSH into the svc hosts? 3) any preferred redaction helper scripts?
chris: short answers: 1) no full payloads in plaintext in tmp unless it's scrubbed. we prefer structured logs + trace ids. 2) ephemeral ssh yes but request via #oncall-access and get approval from oncall lead — see runbook. 3) there is a redaction helper in infra-tools repo `tools/redact_payload.py` (use `--pii` flag)
anita: adding detail: if you must grab a payload for debugging, stash it into an encrypted s3 bucket `s3://redwood-debug/ephemeral/{ticket}` and set a 7d lifecycle. annotate the ticket with why, who approved, and delete when resolved. also avoid screenshots of logs with tokens or emails.
maria: got it — where's the canonical runbook link? i couldn't find the updated access flow.
chris: runbook is at https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/oncall-debugging (bookmark). the access flow header has the short form: submit a request in #oncall-access with `@oncall-lead` + reason + duration (max 2h). for longer access, go through IAM request flow.
sam: small nit: when you paste stack traces into slack, use triple backticks and then run the redaction script locally first. example:
```
python tools/redact_payload.py --pii < raw_payload.json > scrubbed.json
```
then paste scrubbed.json.
security-bot: reminder: service tokens must never be included in logs. automatic detector will DM you if it spots 3+ token-like strings in a single paste. see policy: https://internal.redwood.ai/policies/logging
maria: thanks. one more — ephemeral sudo via bastion: do we still need two approvers or single approver from oncall lead is fine?
chris: single oncall-lead approval is fine for up to 2h. for anything that touches customer data, escalate to sec oncall (anita) for secondary approval.
anita: yes. for customer data (PII), i need to sign off. if you expect to pull >100 records, pause and ping me.
maria: understood. i'll request access in #oncall-access now and attach the ticket id here.
deploy-bot: deployment event: api-prod autoscaler bump detected at 1769812399 — correlate with traces if needed.
maria: created request: #1234 — requested 1h for trace capture. @chris @anita please approve when you can. attaching scrub plan.
chris: approved — please follow the s3 lifecycle step and delete after. :thumbsup:
anita: approved (PII not expected). make sure redaction step ran and put scrubbed artifact in s3.
maria: thanks both — will proceed and update the runbook PR with the small clarifications about the approval channel.
chris: appreciated — if you update the runbook, add a sample access request template. that speeds approvals.
maria: will do. closing thread when done. :white_check_mark:
